# Wedding Data and Privacy Rules

Invitation data is personal event data. Minimize collection and exposure.

Never expose:
- admin credentials
- service-role secrets
- raw invitation tokens in logs
- private home address in public metadata
- guest lists through client-readable endpoints

Use server-side validation for every mutation. RSVP endpoints must be idempotent and protected against duplicate/abusive submissions.

Track invitation activity using invitation IDs rather than putting names, addresses, or full tokens into third-party analytics payloads.

Remember that a URL request can be generated by link preview scanners. Do not classify a guest as having "read" the invitation based only on a server-side request.

Use RLS or equivalent server-side authorization. Admin views must require explicit admin authentication.
